currency.evidence_quote: The Australian Dollar is the legal tender currency of Australia

timezone.evidence_quote: Australia is divided into three primary time zones: Western, Central, and Eastern Standard Time

voltage.evidence_quote: Nominal single-phase voltage in Australia is standardized at 230V (+10% / -6%)

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Mains electricity grid operating frequency in Australia is 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Australian standard AS/NZS 3112 defines Type I two-prong or three-prong angled flat blade plugs

police.evidence_quote: Triple Zero (000) is Australia's primary national emergency contact for police

ambulance.evidence_quote: Emergency ambulance response connects through Triple Zero 000 nationwide

fire.evidence_quote: Fire services emergencies are dispatched directly via Triple Zero 000

general.evidence_quote: 000 is Australia's primary emergency number; mobile 112 redirects automatically to 000
